answer: Agents trading tundra forecasts require each seller identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before it can bid for work. A fresh cipher key creates a new name but cannot reuse a bond already locked to another seller. Attackers may whisper offers through thousands of aliases, yet activating 1,000 sellers still ties up $100,000 for a month, imposing a capital requirement and the cost of forgone returns on that money.
